You own the first weeks of the customer journey: setting up their AI assistant, testing and fine-tuning it, and getting it live on their phone line.

You'll spend most of your time in onboarding calls with customers and inside the fonio platform. You learn how every feature works and figure out the best setup for each customer, whether that's a dental practice in Munich, a law firm in Vienna or a car workshop in Zurich.

 

What to expect

 * Test and fine-tune assistants until they're ready to go live, so customers don't get stuck in "almost done"

 * Help customers connect their phone system and get call forwarding running

 * Follow up with customers who signed but aren't active yet, and get them over the line

 * Become a power user of the platform: learn how each feature works and which setup fits which use case
